source_note: Herrera Sanchez, Gradeci, Ramsay & Khan (Framewave Lab London), 'The life and death of football team runs: survival of collective modes shapes Levy-like transport', arXiv:2609.15541v1 [physics.soc-ph], 14 Sep 2026, 29 pages (main + supplement). Physics-of-football collective transport: links player- and team-centroid Levy-like movement through a FINITE-LIVED collective mode (directional centroid run) whose age and internal order state shape survival. Exact displacement decomposition x_i=X_c+r_i (Eq1) and signed MSD decomposition M_i=M_c+M_rel+C (Eq2); centroid share of player displacement rises with lag (5-30s centroid alpha~1.20 / pitch-player~1.13 superdiffusive, centroid-relative~0.93 diffusive; 1-4s near-ballistic). Polarisation order p=|mean unit velocity| (Eq3). Termination hazard highest at onset, inverse-age decline lambda_0=mu/(a+a_0) (Eq5), state-multiplied + common later-age tempering term (Eq6; multipliers low 1.31/mid 1.00/high 0.67). Age-banded survival-conditional switching (Eq7, bands 0-5/5-10/10-20/20-35s) + live-cohort propagation u_{j+1}=A^T u, A=(1-d)P (Eq8/9); continuous-age McKendrick-von Foerster limit (Eq11-13) separating mass-conserving switching from removing differential termination. Generalised-cutoff duration law p(T)~t^-gamma exp[-(t/T_c)^beta] (Eq15; gamma=1.33/T_c=32.3s/beta=2.78) ranked first of six families but NO family passes absolute goodness-of-fit -> best RELATIVE summary not exact generative law. Data: public SoccerMon GPS (Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.10033832), Rosenborg + Valerenga, Norwegian women's Toppserien 2020+2021; 66 team-match records/62 fixtures/47 dates; 69802 centroid runs/69670 terminations/132 censored/355330 1s intervals; 10Hz->1Hz no interpolation; sticky hierarchical active-XI reconstruction. Grouped leave-one-match-date-out (47 folds): log loss 0.471->0.466->0.464, calibration slope 0.99, Brier 0.148->0.147; high-order survivor fraction ~0.1 birth->>0.5 at 5-7s->~0.2 by 35s (stationary comparator fails, age-banded reproduces); process-removal NOT additive. Order-termination associations modest (OR~0.80 per SD) NOT causal; limited predictive beyond kinematics. Limitations: internal not external validation, exploratory state definitions, segmentation-sensitive, no official substitution logs, incomplete ball/possession/opponent/event data -> cannot identify the football event ending each run; foraging not excluded (different explanation level: why vs how statistical form). Code github.com/framewave-lab/Athlelorien. Extracted faithfully (not a derivative summary). Equations 1-15 and S1-S23 printed in math font that extracts garbled; reconstructed in labeled LaTeX and flagged here and in assumptions. Domain football matches catalog (association football / soccer collective-motion physics; women's Toppserien). Directly isomorphic to GSE's team-translation-vs-formation decomposition, run-lifetime hazard kernel, time-varying collective-state transition, switching-vs-termination two-process attribution, and survivorship-aware heavy-tail interpretation. No sportsbook lines/spreads/totals/implied odds in source or lifted into GSE.

reasoning_traces.think: The retrocausal genealogy of this paper is the collective-transport turn in the physics of football. Guillermo Herrera Sanchez, Daniel Gradeci, Daniele Ramsay, and Safe Khan of Framewave Lab London, posting to arXiv in September 2026 as 2609.15541 in physics.soc-ph, start from the recent report of broad run-length distributions and short-lag superdiffusion in both individual players and team centroids, which had prompted a collective-foraging interpretation, and ask the mechanistic question that a completed-step distribution cannot answer: whether player transport is inherited from a translating team mode, and what controls the lifetime of that mode. The work sits in the lineage of Levy-walk theory, the Edwards critique that broad tails do not identify a unique family, Reynolds and Ouellette's swarm-fluctuation route to Levy flights, Fedotov's interacting-individual and mortal-walker models, and the football collective-dynamics literature on centroids, occupied areas, coordination and recurrent states, while using the public SoccerMon GPS dataset of Rosenborg and Valerenga in the Norwegian women's Toppserien. The recursive theory of mind is the finite-lived collective mode and its age-and-state-dependent survival. The pitch-frame position of each active player is decomposed exactly into the team centroid plus a relative position, and the mean-squared displacement splits exactly into centroid translation, within-formation motion, and a small cross term; at longer lags the centroid carries an increasing share of player displacement, so the centroid is the natural collective coordinate. A directional run of the centroid, segmented at heading changes above thirty degrees, is treated as a finite-lived transport state whose termination hazard is highest at onset, declines with age through an inverse-age baseline, and rises modestly later through a common tempering term, with a low-mid-high order multiplier on the inverse-age component. Cross-layer veto adjudication is the survival-and-reorganisation population model and its honest validation. Order is measured by polarisation, the norm of the mean unit velocity, and the speed-adjusted association with termination is modest — an odds ratio of about zero point eight per standard deviation contemporaneously, shrinking toward null once both correlated speed measures enter — so the authors treat polarisation as one feature of a persistent translating state rather than a large independent protective force, and explicitly deny a causal reading. The live-cohort population is propagated by a survival-times-switching matrix in four age bands, and its continuous-age limit is a McKendrick-von Foerster age-structured balance in which switching conserves live mass while differential termination removes it; the high-order fraction among survivors rises from about one tenth at birth to above one half at five to seven seconds and declines toward one fifth by thirty-five seconds, a trajectory a stationary transition matrix cannot reproduce. The implementation invariants map directly onto GSE. The exact centroid-plus-relative displacement decomposition is GSE's separation of team translation from within-formation rearrangement; the inverse-age-plus-state hazard is GSE's run-vulnerability-at-birth lifetime kernel; the age-banded survival-conditional switching matrix is GSE's time-varying collective-state transition kernel; the mass-conserving-switching versus removing-termination decomposition is GSE's two-process attribution; and the survivorship framing — that trajectory statistics record which dynamical histories survive, not only the rules of motion — is GSE's selection-among-histories interpretation of heavy-tailed movement. The empirical scale and the held-out discipline give the result its weight. The cohort is sixty-six tracked team-match records from sixty-two fixtures on forty-seven match dates across the 2020 and 2021 seasons, yielding sixty-nine thousand eight hundred two centroid runs, sixty-nine thousand six hundred seventy observed terminations, one hundred thirty-two right-censored endings, and three hundred fifty-five thousand three hundred thirty one-second risk intervals, with native ten-hertz GPS reduced to one hertz by keeping the first observation per second and never interpolating missing seconds. Generalisation uses grouped leave-one-match-date-out cross-fitting over forty-seven folds, with the termination model tested as observed-path covariate transfer and the composition model propagated from training-estimated birth distributions without replaying future held-out states; the nested log loss falls from zero point four seven one to zero point four six six to zero point four six four with near-ideal calibration slope zero point nine nine, while the Brier score barely moves, so the gain is likelihood fit and calibration rather than raw accuracy. The caveats close the account with the boundaries that keep the mechanism honest. No candidate duration family passes the absolute goodness-of-fit test, so the generalised-cutoff law with gamma one point three three, cutoff thirty-two point three seconds and beta two point seven eight is a best relative summary, not an exact generative law, and the late downturn is finite-pitch tempering rather than an asymptotic power law. The validation is internal to two clubs and two seasons, the state definitions and age bands are exploratory, run counts are segmentation-sensitive, active players are reconstructed without official substitution logs, and incomplete ball, possession, opponent and event data prevent identifying the football event that ends each run. Foraging is not excluded but relocated to a different level of explanation — why movement occurs versus how its statistical form is generated. The invariant for GSE is to adopt the centroid transport decomposition, the age-and-state termination hazard, the age-banded switching-and-selection population model, and the survivorship interpretation of broad transport, while carrying the no-absolute-fit, the internal-validation, the no-causal-order, and the no-event-attribution limits as honest bounds on what the collective-mode mechanism can claim.

universal_lens: A physics-of-football study links player- and team-level Levy-like transport through a finite-lived collective mode — a directional run of the team centroid — by exactly decomposing player displacement into centroid translation plus within-formation motion, modelling the run's termination hazard as highest at onset then declining with age through an inverse-age baseline with a low-mid-high order multiplier and a common later-age tempering term, and propagating the surviving cohort through age-banded switching and differential termination whose continuous-age limit is a McKendrick-von Foerster balance; the high-order fraction among survivors rises then falls in a way only an age-dependent model reproduces, while the authors honestly treat the best-fitting duration family as a relative summary that passes no absolute goodness-of-fit test, the order-termination link as a modest non-causal association, and the validation as internal to two clubs.
